newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Teledata proposes one-for-one bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Teledata proposes one-for-one bonus issue.

text.p: Teledata Singapore Ltd said on Tuesday it had proposed a bonus issue of 80 million new ordinary shares of Singapore $0.10 each to existing shareholders.
This would be done on the basis of one bonus share for every existing ordinary share of S$0.10 each held in the company at a books closure date to be determined.
The proposal is subject to the approval of the shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting to be held on May 22, and the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES).
